build_composite_loss_criterion: build a composite loss criterion that averages losses across multiple model outputs and targets
configure_underlying_criterion: configure the underlying criterion used by the composite loss via --underlying-criterion argument
apply_loss_weights: apply per-output loss weights to the composite loss via --loss-weights argument
compute_composite_loss_forward: compute the composite loss forward pass across multiple model outputs and their corresponding targets
aggregate_logging_outputs: aggregate logging outputs from the underlying criterion for the composite loss
